monotonic_rules: Every physical change appends a state revision.
Mounted or loaded specimens cannot be transported.
Unloading does not delete previous plastic or loading history.
Rejection never overwrites an earlier observation.
New specimen or camera/fixture geometry cannot inherit an old measurement token.
forbidden: New specimen created by a status label alone
Changing stock parent to repair a mismatch
Reusing a rejected capture file as a retry
Resetting damage or fold history after release
Treating a requested service as observed completion
n_a_policy: Explicit not_applicable plus a scoped reason only where the record type permits it; never omit lineage silently.
fixture_authority: Offline test registries are chosen and regenerated by evaluator code; no production authentication or runtime isolation is implemented.
